candidate.label: Ready-aware hit-and-run (hug when melee up, pull to mid on CD, retreat <40% HP)
candidate.rationale: A positioning RULE a numeric sweep cannot express: it BRANCHES on cooldown state. When the melee special is ready, commit to contact range (34–72px) for max burst; while it recharges, pull out to 58–104px so we are not eating free hits for nothing; below 40% HP push the whole band outward to disengage. Hypothesis: better survival + faster pack clears in multi than the flat default, without sacrificing single-target output.

candidate.rationale: Inverted intuition from pack-count-robust/alternating-oscillator. When the engine says we're winning (_closing high), pull back to 220-290 instead of pressing — trades execute-tempo for survival. Should land in engage bin 0-1, tempo bin 1-2, durability bin 3. Explores whether patience-in-winning is a valid policy class.
